entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ProjectChange_UpdateDirectoryBuildPropsThenUpdateSource timing out #52680
  • Support `dotnetup runtime install` without type to install all runtimes #52679
  • `dotnetup install sdk preview` fails when no preview version is available for latest #52675
  • dnx fails to pass arguments properly when they contain an ampersand (&) #52671
  • Handle existing file-based installs in dotnetup #52668

Closed

  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] The implicit runtime is different with VS carries in the 10.0.200-preview.0 insertion PR build. #52503
  • Blazor WASM Standalone .webmanifest 404 error #51024
  • Blazor WASM builds with wasm workload on Linux need existing Python installation #52332

PullRequests

Created

  • Initial version of a build duty report generator instructions for copilot #52678
  • Fix WASM workload detection for non-Blazor/WasmSdk Exe projects #52677
    Area-Workloads
  • Preview channel falls back to latest GA when no preview releases exist #52676
  • Don't use the portable RIDs for older runtimes if it's empty #52674
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52673
  • Issue 13073 task migration nontrivial 4 #52672

Merged

  • Add .webmanifest MIME type mapping to Blazor WASM web.config template #51025
  • Update Razor code owners #52669
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52632

Updated

  • Update target framework visibility conditions for VS version compatibility #52235
  • Unwind changes done during the TFM update #52512
  • Install `runtime`(s) with `dotnetup` #52649
  • Remove predownload of packages that was originally a workaround #52660
  • [WIP] Add layout logic to replace duplicate files with links (linux only) #52044
  • Auto-enable DOTNET_CLI_CONTEXT_VERBOSE for diagnostic verbosity #52222
  • Add support for creating and editing solution filter (.slnf) files from the CLI #51156
  • Support boolean values for --self-contained flag #52333
  • Add ArtifactsPath to SourceRoot for deterministic builds outside repo #52093
  • Fix duplicate versions in `dotnet workload search version` when multiple feeds contain same version #50980
  • Suppress advertising manifest messages unless verbosity is diagnostic #51560
  • Support trailing commas and comments in .slnf files #51962
  • Fix typo: Indentifer → Identifier in MSBuild item names #52666
  • `dotnet run -e FOO=BAR` passes `@(RuntimeEnvironmentVariable)` #52664
  • dotnet root command and dotnet watch #52583
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52585
  • Add TaskHostFactory tests to guard against regression of #12751 in MSBuild #52405
  • Refactor VSHostObject credential extraction for COM compatibility and out-of-process execution #52552
    Area-Containers
  • sdk tasks migration to the ThreadSafe attribute, simple tasks, part 1 #52554
  • Issue 13073 task migration nontrivial 3 #52603
  • Add `dotnetup env` command to generate shell environment configuration scripts #52641
